5513: Sit on a bench edge with hands beside your hips and heels on a stability ball.
Slide your hips off the bench with arms straight.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees, keeping them close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down and the ball steady.
5514: Lie on your back with knees bent and legs raised.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat to the other side.
Do not pull on your neck.
5515: Hook your feet under the pads on a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
5516: Set your shoulders under the pads and feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Press through your whole foot to stand.
Do not lock your knees hard at the top.
5517: Lie under a bar set at about waist height and grip it with palms facing you.
Hang with your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
5518: Kneel facing a low cable with a handle in one hand.
Lean your torso forward and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
5522: Grab the rings and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulders down.
Pull until the rings reach your chest or chin passes them.
Turn your palms slightly in as you rise if comfortable.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
5524: Set a cable at upper chest height with a single handle.
Stand tall and grab the handle with one hand.
Pull toward your face, elbow high and out.
Rotate your hand back slightly at the end.
Return slowly and switch sides after the set.
5526: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding the hoop against your lower back.
Give it a push and start swinging your hips in circles.
Keep the motion smooth and steady.
Stay tall with a braced core.
Continue for a set time, then switch direction.
5527: Sit on the machine with your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
5528: Set two high pulleys with handles and face away from the stack.
Hold the handles overhead with elbows bent.
Cross your hands as you straighten your arms.
5529: Hold the weight at your shoulders and stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down deeply with chest up.
Use that momentum to press the weight overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulders and repeat.
5537: Stand tall with hands out in front at waist height.
Drive one knee up to tap your hand.
Lower it and switch quickly to the other knee.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a fast, steady pace for time.
5553: Sit at the cable row with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats, then extend slowly.
5554: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
5555: Stand with feet hip width and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
5556: Start at the top of a push-up with straight arms.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor over 3-5 seconds.
Drop to your knees or reset at the bottom.
Return to the top and repeat.
5557: Stand in a doorway with your forearm against the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step through gently with the opposite foot.
Turn away until you feel a chest stretch.
5576: Sit on the machine and grip one handle.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the handle up and forward until the arm is nearly straight.
5577: Stand with a wide stance, toes out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and pull the slack out of the bar.
Lift the bar a few centimetres and pause for 1-2 seconds.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall.
5579: Sit on a bench with forearms on your thighs and wrists past your knees.
Hold the EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Lower the bar by opening your fingers slightly.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
5581: Kneel facing a high cable with a single handle in one hand.
Reach up to a full stretch.
Pull your elbow down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
5582: Stand on a low step with feet together.
Step one leg back and down to the floor.
Lower into a lunge with the front knee over the foot.
Push through the front heel to step back up.
5583: Sit on the machine, set the seat and grab the handles.
Place your legs on the pads and keep your back against the support.
Exhale and crunch your torso and knees toward each other.
Pause when your abs are fully squeezed.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
5598: Stand tall, then hinge forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Drive your knees to your chest alternately for several reps.
Walk your hands back to your feet.
